mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 20 trading days (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in a month, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 shows positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement aggressive tightening, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% yoy, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) reflects a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS increases over the prior 20 trading days (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2.0% signals a contraction in the residential sector, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and economic weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls by >2.0% in a month, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decreases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate a monetary policy response to labor market weakness, which typically precedes a market correction as the economy enters a slowdown phase, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing in response to labor weakness
failure_condition: The S&P 500 shows positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100, with 2017=100), manufacturing output contraction signals a weakening supply chain and reduced corporate investment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO falls below 100, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
